title: Federal Government Will Invest Up to 13 Billion Pesos in Water Works for Jalisco, Sheinbaum Says
author: El Chamuco Staff
content:
_This article by El Chamuco Staff originally appeared in the[October 21, 2026
edition of El Chamuco](https://elchamuco.com.mx/2026/10/21/federacion-
invertira-hasta-13-mil-millones-de-pesos-en-obras-de-agua-para-jalisco-
sheinbaum/), a Mexican political satire and news magazine._

**(OCTOBER 21, 2026).-The President announced that federal resources will go
to water projects to address the supply crisis in Jalisco. The state
government, for its part, is investing around 7.5 billion pesos in a water
treatment plant.**

The Government of Mexico will allocate **between 12 and 13 billion pesos to
water works in Jalisco** to address the water supply crisis in the state,
reported President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo.

The President explained that the federal government will provide the resources
needed to develop the projects, while the state government is investing around
7.5 billion pesos in the construction of a water treatment plant.

“According to what Efraín (Morales, head of Conagua) tells me, it's around 12
billion, 13 billion pesos,” Sheinbaum said.

> [Post by @El_Chamuco on
> X](https://twitter.com/El_Chamuco/status/2112936809311170628)

The President said that this Wednesday a broader review of the planned
investments will take place and alternatives will be analyzed to **finance the
works without resorting to debt**.

The goal, she indicated, is to avoid financial pressures and guarantee
**federal support for the millions of inhabitants of the Guadalajara
metropolitan area**.

Sheinbaum emphasized that the work will be carried out in coordination with
the Jalisco government to move forward on the actions needed to meet the
region's water supply needs.

The details of the projects and the distribution of the resources will be
reviewed during the scheduled meetings between the authorities, as part of the
actions to confront the water crisis in the state.
